scope: Bounded read-only audit plus report writing; no bootstrap optimization, no new quadrature rule, no parameter scan.
scope_of_conclusion: Only the reviewed current/UV helpers and polynomial Gram mapping; not a proof that an M50 joint feasible solution exists.

current_gram_check.arithmetic: float64 random M3 algebra comparison against independent complex Hermitian construction and explicit fixed unitary U
current_gram_check.synthetic_amplitude_operator: N=9, p=22; H physical entries normal_rng*.01; not a physical feasible amplitude
current_gram_check.comparison: unpack current_operators svec versus U.conj().T @ B @ U
current_gram_check.normalization_note: Scalar F0(0)=1 is the paper low-energy approximation in pion units; vector F1(0)=1 is charge normalization.

constant_spectrum_diagnostic.same_input: M50, center0 midpoint nodes, s0=(1.2/.140)^2; only the existing cutoff weight rule differs
constant_spectrum_diagnostic.interpretation: Diagnostic for quadrature sensitivity. These errors are not bounds or estimates for the unknown optimized physical spectral density; no new integration scheme is proposed.

UV_input_comparison.interpretation: Named input conventions, not parameter choices tuned to the paper plots.

tests.command: OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=/tmp/collocation_arb:src python -m pytest -q tests/test_linear.py -k 'fesr_raw or fesr_cutoff or eq250 or gram_map_matches or M50_gram_sizes or exact_Cflat_polynomial' -p no:cacheprovider
tests.current_operator_test_gap: None of the three active test files directly calls current_operators/current_gram. Historical independent checks exist; current M3 comparison above was rerun during this audit.

quotient_Gram.role: Nonnegative high-spin polynomial lift, distinct from the D1 current Gram
quotient_Gram.PV_sampled_policy: Do not add this strengthened-branch cone to the declared PV sampled model.

D3_readiness.amplitude_only_solver: linear.py:192-193 only accepts free=2M or2M+1; the joint4076-variable layout is not accepted
D3_readiness.required: Connect the same full3876 amplitude coefficients to200 current variables,100 real3x3 PSDs,four moment bands,14 FF cones; retain original scattering/chiral/density constraints; validate all current duals and residuals in a joint support certificate.

immediately_bounded_steps: D1 actual M50 preparation and active independent current-matrix regression
D2 explicit current/UV units and cutoff diagnostic acceptance
recommendation.next_gate: D3 needs a real joint solve and independent joint primal/dual validation before E/F production.
recommendation.precision: No guaranteed physical percent precision follows from the current helper checks. Arb precision controls arithmetic only; declared tolerances, cutoff sensitivity, input convention and M/L effects remain separate.
